description:
Before Aisha’s father passes away, he leaves his daughter his vast fortune on the condition that she finds a husband in six months. Skeptical of love and surrounded by greedy debt-ridden relatives, Aisha decides to simply buy a husband with money. Her search for a commoner with nothing to his name leads her to the strikingly handsome jockey, Weiz. However, Weiz doesn't seem like a normal commoner, with his commanding presence and mysterious ties to the imperial family. As her calculated business deal turns into a heated exchange, Aisha realizes she may have bought more than she bargained for.

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: The sixth story in Metatoon's Gyeryak Danpyeonseon (계략 단편선) Collection.*
